changelog:
Initial release: Comprehensive guide for optimizing writing and translation with the kb-vn skill set.

- Explains how/why AI skills bypass filters differently from normal chat, and how to leverage this for better results.
- Details the effective use of context window, temperature, and model selection for VN writing pipelines.
- Breaks down each kb-vn skill (lorebuilding, outlining, POV control, fullwrite, lexicon, lorefilter, translation, roleplay) and their roles in the workflow.
- Introduces clear pipelines for writing and translating stories, with practical advice for maximizing AI output quality.
- Offers best practices and real-world tips specifically for users who know the basics.
summary: Hướng dẫn toàn diện — giải thích how/why, sửa lỗi người dùng, tối ưu pipeline viết gốc & dịch thuật với bộ kỹ năng kb-vn. Version dành cho người đã biết basics.
